title: DSD inventory row
description: One headword selected for the DSD corpus. Selection is a product decision recorded with its rationale and author. This schema documents the CSV contract; scripts/dsd/inventory.ts is the enforcing implementation and additionally rejects legacy-bearing columns by name.

dsd_entry_id.description: Fresh DSD UUID allocated before import so curation packages reference the same entry in every environment. Never a legacy identifier.

headword.description: English headword. Latin letters, apostrophe, hyphen and single spaces only; at most 4 words and 40 characters. Longer values or sentence punctuation indicate a definition pasted into the wrong column.

part_of_speech_expectation.description: Expected part of speech. A hint for authoring, not a published fact.

dsd_priority.description: DSD-owned learning priority. Never an imported frequency rank.

dsd_band.description: Optional grouping label, e.g. core or extended.

product_rationale.description: Why DSD teaches this word. Required: inventory selection is a product decision and must be defensible as independent of any source dictionary.

author_contributor_id.description: Pseudonymous contributor ID from data/dsd/contributor-registry.json. Names never enter Git.

declaration_id.description: Signed clean-room declaration covering this batch.

$comment: Forbidden columns, rejected by name with an explanatory error: word_id, definition_id, source_definition_id, source_sense_id, example_id, legacy_id, definition, definition_en, definition_vi, translation, translation_vi, example, example_en, example_vi, ipa, pronunciation, frequency_rank, ngsl_rank, oewn_sense_id.
